try: Open your company's profile
how:
1. Click "Company" in the side navigation
2. Click "Profile"
expect: "Company details" shows Demo Studio Pte Ltd, its UEN and address; below come "Registrations & accreditations", "Listed on Qanvast" and "Issuing entities & bank details".
in10: Different from 1.0: company records live under Company, not Accounts

try: Add a tagline and your Instagram handle
how:
1. In "Tagline" type Homes that feel like you
2. Under "Social links", in "Instagram" type @demostudio.sg
3. Click "Save changes"
expect: A message says "Company details saved"; "Save changes" and "Discard" grey out until you change something again.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Check the studio's bank details and add its PayNow QR
how:
1. Scroll to "Issuing entities & bank details"
2. For Demo Studio Pte Ltd check "Bank" (DBS Bank), "Account number", "SWIFT / BIC" and "PayNow (UEN or mobile)" are already filled
3. Click the "PayNow QR" box and pick paynow-qr.png
4. Click "Save changes"
expect: "PayNow QR added", then "Company details saved"; a QR code now sits in the box beside the bank fields.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Add a second company you issue quotes under
how:
1. Click "Add an entity"
2. "Entity name": Demo Studio Carpentry Pte Ltd
3. Switch off "GST-registered"; under "Letterhead" fill "UEN / Co. Reg. No." 202512345K
4. Click "Save changes"
expect: "Company details saved". The new company has its own bank, PayNow and letterhead fields, and a bin to remove it, since nothing uses it yet.
in10: Different from 1.0: an entity in use is retired, never deleted

try: Look at the brand kit every template starts from
how:
1. At the bottom of Profile, click "Brand kit"
2. Read the page without changing anything
expect: "Templates" opens on its "Brand kit" tab: "Logo and marks", "Colours" and "Fonts", with the default template's first page on the right.
in10: Different from 1.0: one kit every template starts from

try: See who works in the studio and their roles
how:
1. Click "Company" in the side navigation
2. Click "Members"
expect: "People and roles": Dane (you) is the Owner; James is a Manager with "Team: Michelle, Sarah"; every row has a role and a lead count.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Add a new designer to the team
how:
1. Click "Add member"
2. "Name": Kavya Menon · "Role": Designer · "Phone": 9123 4567 · "Email": kavya@demostudio.sg
3. Click "Add member"
expect: Under "Phone": "A mobile signs them in and gets the invitation"; above the buttons: "We’ll send Kavya an invitation by WhatsApp and email — a link to join, open for 30 days." Then "Kavya Menon added and invited" (with "Set who they report to"); her row wears a yellow "Invited" chip and "0 leads".
in10: Different from 1.0: 1.0 only emailed a request to OpenMaison

try: Put Kavya in James's team
how:
1. In Kavya's row open "Reports to"
2. Pick James
expect: "Kavya Menon now reports to James"; James's row now reads "Team: Kavya Menon, Michelle, Sarah".
in10: Different from 1.0: every studio can have managers

try: Tell the studio which leads Kavya should get
how:
1. In Kavya's row click "Preferences"
2. "Specialty": Condo kitchens
3. Beside "Property type" set "Priority" to "Must match", then pick the "Condo 3-bedder" chip
4. Click "Save preferences"
expect: "Lead preferences saved"; her row reads "Condo kitchens · Condo 3-bedder (must)".
in10: Different from 1.0: four categories; Scope is left out

try: Stop new leads going to Kavya for now
how: 1. In Kavya's row switch off "Open to new leads"
expect: "Kavya Menon is closed to new leads"; a yellow "Closed to new leads" tag appears on her row.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Try to change your own role
how: 1. On your own row (Dane), point at the "Role" box
expect: The box is greyed out and a tip says "You’re the studio’s Owner — make another member an Owner, then they can change your role."
in10: Different from 1.0: the rule is enforced, not just hidden

try: Cancel Kavya's invitation, then change your mind
how:
1. In Kavya's row click "Cancel invitation"
2. Click "Undo" in the message at the bottom
expect: "Invitation to Kavya Menon cancelled"; after Undo: "Kavya Menon’s invitation is back" — her row says "Invited" again, still in James's team.
in10: Different from 1.0: cancelling an invitation has Undo

try: Deactivate Germaine, then bring her back
how:
1. In Germaine's row click "Deactivate"
2. Read the box, then click "Deactivate"
3. Find her under "Deactivated" and click "Reactivate"
expect: The box names her open leads; "Deactivated" lists her as "Designer · deactivated" today; Reactivate says "Germaine reactivated — back in every picker".
in10: New in 2.0

scene: The studio's rules at a glance
try: Open the studio's settings
how:
1. Click "Settings" in the side navigation
2. Read the tabs, then click "Finance" and read its cards
3. Click "Projects" and read its cards
expect: Settings opens on "Roles & access"; the tabs read Roles & access · Lead management · Meetings · Projects · Quotes & pricing · Finance · Notifications. "Finance" opens with "Document numbers", then "Money in" (Invoices · Invoice paper · Client payments · Credit notes), "Money out" (Costs · Expense categories · The purchase order paper) and "Commission". "Projects" opens with "What waits for an Owner or an Admin", then Project numbers · Stages and handover · Schedule · Ticket categories · Workload · Compliance.
in10: Different from 1.0: seven tabs instead of one long Accounts page

scene: The studio's rules at a glance
try: Find where the team and your companies are kept
how:
1. On "Roles & access", read the line under the title and "Kept in Company:"
2. Click "Members", look at Kavya’s row, then go back
3. Click "Profile" and scroll to "Issuing entities & bank details"
expect: The line says its team is on Members and the companies it issues quotes and contracts under are on Profile; Members shows Kavya reporting to James; Profile lists Demo Studio Pte Ltd and Demo Studio Carpentry Pte Ltd.
in10: New in 2.0

scene: The studio's rules at a glance
try: See what each role is allowed to do
how: 1. On "Roles & access", scroll to "Who may do what"
expect: A table of actions against Owner, Admin, Manager, Designer and Accounting, grouped by area: ticks, dashes or words like "Submits for approval". Nothing here can be edited.
in10: Different from 1.0: fixed roles stated plainly; no permissions editor

try: Try both ways leads can move, then keep Linear
how:
1. Click the "Lead management" tab
2. Under "Lead stages", in "How leads move" click "Flexible"
3. Click "Linear"
expect: "Stage movement set to Flexible", then "Stage movement set to Linear"; Linear ends up selected.
in10: Different from 1.0: Linear / Flexible replace Classic / Journey

try: Add Xiaohongshu as a place leads come from
how:
1. Under "Lead sources", type Xiaohongshu in "Add a source"
2. Click "Add"
expect: "Xiaohongshu added to the lead sources"; it appears just before "Others" with a count of 0.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Move Xiaohongshu to the top of the list
how:
1. Click the name "Xiaohongshu"
2. In the "Lead source" box set "Place in the list" to 1
3. Click "Save"
expect: "Lead sources saved"; Xiaohongshu is now first in the list.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Rename Walk-in and see its lead follow
how:
1. Click "Walk-in" and change "Name" to Showroom walk-in
2. Click "Save"
3. Open Leads and find Mei Ling Tan's "Source"
expect: "Walk-in is now Showroom walk-in — its leads follow"; Mei Ling Tan's source reads Showroom walk-in.
in10: Different from 1.0: a rename carries the leads with it

try: Add a Lost reason that expects two logged contacts
how:
1. Back in Settings, open "Lead management" and find "Lost and On Hold reasons"
2. In "Add a Lost reason" type Chose a contractor; in "Contacts expected first" type 2 (the line under it says what the number does)
3. Click "Add"
expect: "Chose a contractor added to the Lost reasons"; it shows as "Chose a contractor · after 2 contacts", just before "Others".
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Add your own field to every lead
how:
1. Under "Custom fields" click "Add field"
2. "Label": Preferred contact time · "Type": Dropdown
3. Options: Morning, Afternoon, Evening ("Add option" for each new one)
4. Click "Add"
expect: "Preferred contact time added"; the table shows it with a "Dropdown" tag, its three options, Required off and Active on.
in10: Different from 1.0: saving never erases the leads' answers

try: Limit designers to their own leads, then open it back up
how:
1. Click the "Roles & access" tab; under "Who sees leads" click "Only the leads assigned to them"
2. Read the "See a lead" row of "Who may do what" below
3. Click "Everyone sees every lead"
expect: "Designers now see only their own leads, and Managers their own and their team’s"; "See a lead" reads "Their team’s" for Managers and "Their own" for Designers; the last click says "Everyone sees every lead again".
in10: Different from 1.0: one switch, enforced for every role

try: Find the address your website form sends leads to
how:
1. Click the "Lead management" tab, then "Integrations" beside "Kept in Company:"
2. Under "Website form by email" click "Copy" beside the address
3. Read the cards below it
expect: "Intake address copied" (leads+demo-studio@in.openmaison.sg). Below it: "Meta Lead Ads", "Webhooks" ("1 active": Google Ads), "Email lead sources" and "Xero".
in10: Different from 1.0: every way in listed in one place

try: Try your own quote number pattern without saving it
how:
1. Back in Settings, click the "Quotes & pricing" tab
2. Under "Quote numbers" change "Prefix" to DS and "Digits" to 4; switch on "Year and month"
3. Read "Next quote:"
4. Click "Discard"
expect: "Next quote:" changes as you type to DS-(this year and month)-0001; after Discard it reads OM-10010 again.
in10: Different from 1.0: your own pattern, not a fixed QT-###

try: Give Carpentry a standard note for quotes
how:
1. Under "Trades" click "Carpentry"
2. In "Note" type All carpentry in E0-grade board with laminate finish unless stated.
3. Click "Save"
expect: "Note saved for Carpentry"; a small note mark appears on the Carpentry chip.
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Check the GST rate refuses a wrong number
how:
1. Under "GST" read where registration is set ("Company › Profile")
2. Change "GST rate (%)" to 35
3. Change it back to 9
expect: At 35 the box says "Between 0 and 30" and "Save rate" stays grey; back at 9 the warning goes.
in10: Different from 1.0: the studio sets its GST once

try: Round selling prices to S$5, then switch it off
how:
1. Under "Selling prices", in "Round selling prices to" pick "The nearest S$5"
2. Pick "Not rounded" again
expect: "Selling prices round to the nearest S$5", then "Selling prices are not rounded".
in10: Different from 1.0: a studio rule instead of per quote

try: Lock payment schedules to Owners and Admins, then unlock
how:
1. Under "Who may change the payment schedule" switch on "Only Owners and Admins can change it"
2. On the "Roles & access" tab read "Change a quote’s payment schedule"
3. Back on "Quotes & pricing", switch it off
expect: Locked, Manager, Designer and Accounting show "—" on that row; unlocking says "Every member can change the payment schedule".
in10: Different from 1.0: the lock is now actually enforced

try: Make James the backup approver, then remove him
how:
1. Under "Backup approver" pick James
2. On the "Roles & access" tab read the line under "Who may do what"
3. Back on "Quotes & pricing", pick "None"
expect: "James can approve as the backup"; Roles & access says "James is the backup approver…"; picking None says "No backup approver".
in10: Different from 1.0: one backup instead of an approver list

try: Choose whose name a quote's "prepared by" prints
how:
1. Under "Prepared by", in "Prepared by prints" pick "Every member on the lead"
2. Pick "The member who prepared the quote" again
expect: "Prepared by prints every member on the lead", then "Prepared by prints the member who prepared the quote".
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Switch off a notice and see email and WhatsApp follow
how:
1. Click the "Notifications" tab
2. On "A new lead arrives" switch off "In app"
3. Point at its greyed "WhatsApp" switch
4. Switch "In app" back on
expect: Email and WhatsApp go grey and off; the tip says "Goes out with the in-app notice — switch In app on first"; both return after.
in10: Different from 1.0: set per event, not per category

try: Preview a WhatsApp message with a field filled in
how:
1. Under "Message wording", on "A new lead arrives · WhatsApp" click "Edit"
2. Click at the end of "Message", then "Insert a field" › "The lead’s source"
3. Read "Preview"
4. Click "Cancel"
expect: The preview fills the new field with a sample source ("Website"); Cancel leaves the message as it was.
in10: Same as 1.0

scene: Leave the studio as you found it
try: Put the lead sources back as they were
how:
1. On "Lead management" click ✕ on Xiaohongshu, then "Undo" in the message
2. Click ✕ on Xiaohongshu again
3. Click "Showroom walk-in", change "Name" back to Walk-in, click "Save"
expect: Undo says "Lead sources put back"; at the end the note under "Lead sources" says "These are the defaults."
in10: Different from 1.0: removing answers with Undo, not a confirm

scene: Leave the studio as you found it
try: Remove the test reason and the test field
how:
1. Under "Lost and On Hold reasons" click ✕ on "Chose a contractor"
2. Under "Custom fields" click the bin on "Preferred contact time"
3. Click "Delete" in "Delete this field?"
expect: "Chose a contractor removed", "Preferred contact time deleted"; Lost and On Hold reasons says "These are the defaults." and Custom fields "No custom fields yet."
in10: Same as 1.0

scene: Leave the studio as you found it
try: Take the Carpentry note off again
how:
1. On "Quotes & pricing" click "Carpentry"
2. Clear "Note"
3. Click "Save"
expect: "Note removed from Carpentry"; the small note mark leaves the Carpentry chip.
in10: Same as 1.0

scene: Leave the studio as you found it
try: Leave Kavya out and remove the test company
how:
1. Company › "Members": click "Cancel invitation" on Kavya's row
2. Company › "Profile": click the bin on Demo Studio Carpentry Pte Ltd
3. Click "Save changes"
4. Open Settings › "Roles & access" and read the heads of "Who may do what"
expect: "Invitation to Kavya Menon cancelled" and she moves under "Deactivated"; Profile lists one entity, Demo Studio Pte Ltd; the heads read "Designer · 4".
in10: Same as 1.0

scene: One more check on your team
try: Try an office landline as a new member’s only way in
how:
1. Company › "Members" › "Add member"; open "Role" and read the list
2. "Name" Test Landline · "Phone" 6222 0188 · leave "Email" empty; press "Add member"
3. Type test@demostudio.sg in "Email" and read "Phone" again
4. Press "Cancel"
expect: Role lists Marketing beside the other roles. With no email, the landline is refused under Phone: "Enter a mobile number (8 or 9 first) — the sign-in code goes there"; nobody is added. With an email beside it the message goes — the landline is then just their number. Cancel adds no one.
in10: Different from 1.0: a landline can’t be the only way in
